hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5 Strength plus strong two-unit PLAY buff and King access
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: King Name immediately regains 2 Command and offers a once-per-Battle classification-wide Strength bonus

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Scout with once-per-Battle two-step Move (Action required)
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Limited information is worth less than regular Names' more reliable combat or card benefits; a Hero Name also occupies the one-per-Battle Hero slot.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5-Strength Raider with PLAY tax/hand-return attack on prepared layers
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name suppresses an attached effect on completion and can impose a one-use local Tax

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Guard with continuous Tactic-cost screening for its rank
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: A one-time conditional marker cleanse and redirect compares more closely to 2C protection Names than to a 3C persistent engine.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 2-Strength Steward draws 2 and discards 1 when played
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name regains 2 Command and provides persistent global Bond/Name price reductions

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Force attaches a prepared layer immediately
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name recovers a discarded Bond and attaches prepared layers once per Battle

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength Rider with a free-Command once-per-Battle Move Action
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name repositions an ally on completion and has a once-per-Battle Move Action

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength Force clears a harmful marker on entry
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name protects itself from suppression and makes opposing targeted Tactics cost more

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Seer offers strong on-PLAY top-three deck selection
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Narrative recursion requires a suitable discard and further Actions; it has a weaker opening-Battle floor than other 3C Names.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength King/Archer with a Bonded +1 Strength condition
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: The transient Archer buff and paid -1 Strength Action underperform 2C Corin's persistent Archer support in many positions.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5-Strength Force gains a persistent +1 when Bonded and Frontline
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Regain 1 Command and Tactic-specific Strength protection compares directly to Edrin's 1C regain and broader one-use affliction prevention.

strength_adjustments.reason: Conditional healer Action needs another Action and an afflicted Force ahead; +1 printed Strength restores a viable default body without changing the effect or cost.
